meta.source: HKSI Paper 1 Study Room canvas, restyled toward a minimal workspace look (dark navigation rail, one blue, square corners, hairline borders)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground, reading column, cards, inputs, assistant bubbles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Assistant panel, table and card headers, callouts. Text on it: `ink-muted` or darker (5.1:1).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Resting fill of pill tabs and quiz option keys; row hover on light panels.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Ghost button hover on light ground; progress track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, UI labels and titles on `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `accent-soft` (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long-form reading text, callout and feedback text.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Field labels, lead paragraphs, ghost-button text and icons. 8:1 on `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, table and eyebrow labels, timestamps, faded quiz options. 5.4:1 on surface, 5.1:1 on `surface-sunken`, 4.7:1 on `surface-muted`: never lighter.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour: primary button fill, links on `surface` (4.7:1), focus rings, progress fills, correct-answer border.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover; link hover; any accent text on a tint (5.6:1 on `accent-soft`).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button active; text on `accent-tint` (6.6:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` (4.7:1) and darker.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected pill tab, pressed toggle, correct option and feedback, user chat bubble. Text on it: `ink` or `accent-hover`, not `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Avatar square and web badge, with `accent-pressed` text.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Progress fills on light ground: 3.8:1 on `surface-hover`.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The dark navigation rail holding the chapter list, logo and account.

tokens.name: rail-raised
tokens.usage: Progress card and other grouped blocks on the rail.

tokens.name: rail-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and active chapter rows; unread number squares.

tokens.name: rail-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on the rail; the chapter progress track.

tokens.name: on-rail
tokens.usage: Titles and labels on `rail` (13.5:1) and `rail-hover`.

tokens.name: on-rail-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines and section labels on the rail: 6.8:1 on `rail`, 5.1:1 on `rail-hover`.

tokens.name: rail-accent
tokens.usage: Progress fill and the finished-chapter square on the rail (4.7:1 on `rail-line`, 7.3:1 on `rail`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, options, chips and the pill search field. 1.6:1 on surface, below the 3:1 floor for control borders by design: every control also has a visible label or text and a solid `accent` focus ring.

tokens.name: line-divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines under headers, between table rows and between card columns.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card, table and assistant-bubble borders.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sign-in error text, wrong-answer border, verdict and key fill (white on it 6.6:1). Always with a cross icon and words.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer option and feedback ground (`danger` text 5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Letter on a `danger` key.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a slid-over panel on mobile.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: 3px halo around a focused text field.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in and home greeting only; regular weight, in `ink`.

styles.name: transition-title
styles.usage: Chapter name on the transition screen.

styles.name: chapter-title
styles.sample: Regulatory Overview of the Hong Kong Financial Industry
styles.usage: One per chapter, at the top of the reading column.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Numbered sections inside a chapter.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles of cards and panels ('Study assistant', 'Recent').

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The overall-progress figure, tabular numerals.

styles.name: end-line
styles.sample: You scored 2 of 2 on this chapter’s questions.
styles.usage: End-of-chapter summary line.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Before the rules, the map: who regulates what in Hong Kong.
styles.usage: Chapter intro under the title, in `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Hong Kong largely follows an institutional model.
styles.usage: Chapter body text and list items, in `ink-body`, max `size-measure` wide.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Quiz question stem.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav rows, quiz options, table cells: the default UI size.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Chat bubbles, chips, feedback text, card descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and small headings; 400 for breadcrumbs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, counters, badges, keyboard hints.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a chapter title, in `accent-hover`.

styles.name: eyebrow-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: table headers, rail section titles, callout and quiz labels, in `ink-muted` or `on-rail-muted`.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: `display` below 700px.

styles.name: chapter-title-mobile
styles.usage: `chapter-title` and `transition-title` on phones.

styles.name: section-heading-mobile
styles.usage: `section-heading` on phones.

styles.name: lead-mobile
styles.usage: `lead` on phones.

styles.name: reading-mobile
styles.sample: Hong Kong largely follows an institutional model.
styles.usage: `reading` on phones: same size, slightly tighter leading.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rail rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label to field; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between quiz options, chips and tabs; icon-to-text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row and option padding; small card padding; message stack.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Field and button side padding; card inner gap; rail side gutter.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding; paragraph spacing; reading gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Quiz card padding; panel gutters.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between page sections on the home and sign-in screens.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Above a section heading; card column padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Top padding of the reading column; page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, quiz option keys, tags.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, quiz options, chips, feedback: nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tables, tiles, callouts, progress card, avatar, number squares, rail rows.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Quiz card, chat bubbles, end-of-chapter panel.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: One hero card per screen (e.g. the sign-in card).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill tabs, the assistant toggle and search fields only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Typing dots and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Barely-there lift on the quiz card; everything else separates by border.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A side panel slid over the page on mobile.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focused text field, with an `accent` border.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary button and fields on sign-in; controls on phones.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button, input, toggle, icon button and quiz option minimum.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline actions ('Try again'), pill tabs. Desktop only.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Top bar and panel headers.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: The dark chapter rail on desktop and as a mobile drawer.

tokens.name: size-panel-right
tokens.usage: Study assistant panel on desktop (full width on mobile).

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the reading column.

tokens.name: size-signin
tokens.usage: Max width of the sign-in form.
